column1: # Other descriptions of a Tangut character: a reader's analysis of the same glyph, kept beside the
# record's own description and never instead of it. One line per description:
# char<TAB>IDS<TAB>source<TAB>detail<TAB>lang (the detail's language; required with a detail)
# The parts index reads these too, so a character is found from the parts this analysis names; the
# card shows the analysis with its source, and the description the record carries still draws the
# structure and decides the parts a character splits into.
# The IDS here is this project's writing of the analysis: operands in the order IDS gives them, so
# ⿴𘋢𘠣 puts the enclosing 𘋢 first and the enclosed 𘠣 second.
